questions.a: (a) (-1, 10) maximum and (3, -22) minimum (b) OM = a + ½c (c) A ∩ B = {6, 12}; n((A ∪ B)′) = 4 (d) 8

questions.q: For the curve in (a), find the gradient at x = 1 and the equation of the tangent there.
OA = a and OB = b. P divides AB in the ratio 1 : 3. Find OP.
questions.a: OP = a + ¼(b - a) = ¾a + ¼b
